b1-kiegyezes-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Resisting Bach's Rule
b1-kiegyezes-01.scenario: You are preparing for your citizenship interview. The examiner asks what Ferenc Deák and the Hungarian lords did after the defeat of 1849.
b1-kiegyezes-01.prompt: Tell the examiner that Deák stood by the constitutional rights even though the revolution failed, and say what the Hungarian lords did not do.
cues: Say that Deák held on to the constitutional rights although the revolution failed
Say what the Hungarian lords refused to do
b1-kiegyezes-01.target: Annak ellenére, hogy a forradalom elbukott, Deák kitartott az alkotmányos jogok mellett. A magyar urak nem működtek együtt az osztrák hivatalokkal.
b1-kiegyezes-01.english: Even though the revolution failed, Deák stood by the constitutional rights. The Hungarian lords did not cooperate with the Austrian offices.
b1-kiegyezes-01.canDo: I can say how Hungarians resisted Bach's rule without weapons after 1849.

b1-kiegyezes-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Easter Article
b1-kiegyezes-02.scenario: At a small museum about Ferenc Deák a visitor asks you, a learner preparing for the citizenship interview, why Deák wrote the Easter Article and when it appeared.
b1-kiegyezes-02.prompt: Tell the visitor why Deák wrote the Easter Article and in which year it appeared.
cues: Say why Deák wrote the article
Say the year it appeared, at Easter
b1-kiegyezes-02.target: Deák azért írta a Húsvéti cikket, hogy megnyissa az utat a tárgyalások előtt. 1865 húsvétján jelent meg.
b1-kiegyezes-02.english: Deák wrote the Easter Article to open the way for negotiations. It appeared at Easter 1865.
b1-kiegyezes-02.canDo: I can say who Ferenc Deák was and what the Easter Article of 1865 offered.

b1-kiegyezes-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Coronation of 1867
b1-kiegyezes-03.scenario: On a tour of the Buda Castle district the guide asks you what you know about the coronation of Franz Joseph in 1867.
b1-kiegyezes-03.prompt: Tell the guide where and when Franz Joseph was crowned king of Hungary, and what the king swore.
cues: Say where and in which year he was crowned
Say what the king swore to do
b1-kiegyezes-03.target: Ferenc Józsefet 1867-ben a Mátyás-templomban magyar királlyá koronázták. A király esküt tett, hogy megtartja az ország alkotmányát.
b1-kiegyezes-03.english: Franz Joseph was crowned king of Hungary in Matthias Church in 1867. The king took an oath that he would keep the country's constitution.
b1-kiegyezes-03.canDo: I can say when, where and by whom Franz Joseph was crowned king of Hungary.

b1-kiegyezes-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Common and Hungarian Affairs
b1-kiegyezes-04.scenario: At your citizenship interview the examiner asks what was common and what was Hungarian in the dual system after 1867.
b1-kiegyezes-04.prompt: Tell the examiner which affairs stayed common and which affairs Pest managed itself.
cues: Say which affairs Pest managed itself
b1-kiegyezes-04.target: Egyrészt a külügy és a hadügy közös maradt, másrészt a belügyeket Pest intézte.
b1-kiegyezes-04.english: On the one hand foreign affairs and defence stayed common; on the other hand Pest managed domestic affairs.
b1-kiegyezes-04.canDo: I can say which affairs were common and which were Hungarian after 1867.

b1-kiegyezes-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What Changed after 1867
b1-kiegyezes-05.scenario: A teacher at your language school asks you to sum up what the Compromise changed for Hungary and what it did not solve.
b1-kiegyezes-05.prompt: Tell the teacher what the Compromise made possible and that the internal tensions remained.
cues: Say what the Compromise made possible
Say that the internal tensions remained
b1-kiegyezes-05.target: A kiegyezés lehetővé tette a gazdasági fellendülést, ugyanakkor a belső feszültségek megmaradtak.
b1-kiegyezes-05.english: The Compromise made the economic boom possible, but at the same time the internal tensions remained.
b1-kiegyezes-05.canDo: I can say what changed in Hungary's economy and cities after 1867.

b1-kiegyezes-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: 1867 in Review
b1-kiegyezes-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the unit your teacher asks you for a short summary of 1867 for the citizenship interview.
b1-kiegyezes-consolidation.prompt: Tell the teacher who the prime minister was in 1867 and where Franz Joseph was crowned.
cues: Say who the prime minister was in 1867
Say where Franz Joseph was crowned
b1-kiegyezes-consolidation.target: 1867-ben Andrássy Gyula volt a miniszterelnök. Ferenc Józsefet a Mátyás-templomban koronázták magyar királlyá.
b1-kiegyezes-consolidation.english: In 1867 Gyula Andrássy was the prime minister. Franz Joseph was crowned king of Hungary in Matthias Church.
b1-kiegyezes-consolidation.canDo: I can review the people, places and events of the 1867 Compromise.
